title: kyverno-policies (koorikla wrapper)
description: Platform keys only; the upstream kyverno-policies subchart, cluster.* and installation keys stay open. Cross-field rules: templates/validate.yaml.

kyverno-policies.description: Upstream kyverno/kyverno-policies subchart values (not constrained here).

imageVerification.description: Supply-chain gate: signature + attestation ImageValidatingPolicies per environment tier.

environments.description: OpenChoreo environment -> action (Audit warns, Deny blocks).

defaultAction.description: Action for every environment not listed in environments (empty: unchecked).

github.description: Keyless (GitHub OIDC) source: images built by the pinned reusable workflow.

enabled.description: Trust keyless signatures from GitHub Actions.

prefixes.description: Image reference prefixes this source covers.

workflow.description: Reusable workflow URL without a ref (the ref is workflowRef); required while github.enabled.

workflowRef.description: 40-hex commit SHA of the workflow (tags and branches are mutable); required while github.enabled.

transitionWorkflowRefs.description: The previous workflow commit, trusted while app repos move (at most one).

repositories.description: GitHub repositories (owner/name) whose builds are trusted.

refs.description: Git refs whose builds are trusted (e.g. refs/heads/main).

triggers.description: Workflow trigger events whose builds are trusted (e.g. push).

attestations.description: Attestations every image of this source needs (names from attestationTypes).

platformKey.description: Platform-key source: images the workflow plane pushed to <registry.host>/<registry.appsProject>/.

enabled.description: Trust images signed with the platform cosign key.

publicKey.description: Inline cosign public key (PEM); empty: the per-cluster ConfigMap when registry.type is harbor.

cluster.description: Where charts/cluster delivers the key per workload cluster.

namespace.description: Namespace of the key ConfigMap (addon kyverno's namespace).

configMap.description: Key ConfigMap name; empty disables the cluster-delivered key.

attestations.description: Attestations every platform-built image needs (names from attestationTypes).

extraTrustedPrefixes.description: Extra registry prefixes trusted without signature verification.

workflowImageDigests.description: Workflow-plane Pods must use digest-pinned images.

enabled.description: Render the policy (on the cluster that runs the workflow plane).

failurePolicy.description: Fail: Kyverno down blocks new run Pods; Ignore admits them unchecked.

enabled.description: Render the preview guards (mgmt: expiry/cap; data planes: quota/isolation).

ttl.description: Preview lifetime in hours and/or minutes (e.g. 48h).

ttlGrace.description: Delete this long after expires-at, hours and/or minutes (e.g. 1h).

host.description: Registry host[:port] of platform-built images; required when a platform key is trusted.

appsProject.description: Registry project of platform-built app images (empty: apps).
